meetings.title: Cold Start
meetings.summary: The inaugural meeting for the 2026-2027 school year. Get set up to contribute to this year's projects! We've simplified the onboarding process this year, and we're excited to get everyone rocking and rolling for the rest of the semester.

agenda.title: Collaborative Coding
agenda.description: Get set up with the DevDogs Monorepo, understand best practices on how to contribute to a large codebase, and learn the basics of working with Git and GitHub.

meetings.title: Interest Meeting
meetings.summary: Come meet the new leadership team and get the details on all things DevDogs! If you're returning, you can learn more about what's changing, what's staying the same, and how to get involved this year. We'll have free food!

meetings.title: Build Session #1
meetings.summary: Catch up on workshop materials, meet up with your teammates for hackathons, get unblocked with support from focus leads and club officers, or just come hang out and get work done!

meetings.title: Workshops: Next.js and Flutter
meetings.summary: A framework double-header: build for the web with Next.js and go cross-platform with Flutter.

meetings.title: Workshop: Career Fair Readiness

meetings.title: DevDogs Touch Grass #1
meetings.summary: No laptops required! Destress from midterms and the chaos of the semester. Just come outside, get some air, and hang out with the club. We'll have snacks, card games, Minecraft, Jackbox, Mario Kart, Mario Party, and more!
